name: vscode-reg
description: Syntax highlighting for .reg files and a read-only offline registry hive viewer with language model tools.

languageModelTools.name: registry_read_hive
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read subkeys and values from an offline Windows registry hive without mounting it or requiring administrator privileges. Results include openUri fields. When citing a returned key or value, use its openUri as the target of a Markdown link so the user can open that exact registry location.

path.description: Absolute path to the hive file.

key.description: Registry key path relative to the hive root. Empty means root.

languageModelTools.name: registry_search_hive
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search key paths, value names, and textual value data in an offline Windows registry hive. Results are bounded and read-only. Each result includes an openUri field. When citing a result, use openUri as the target of a Markdown link so the user can open that exact registry location.

path.description: Absolute path to the hive file.

languageModelTools.name: registry_query_hive
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Query an offline hive cache with a safe SQL-like WHERE expression. Fields: kind, key/path/key_path, name/value_name, type/value_type, type_code, size/value_size, data, last_write/lastWrite (ISO 8601 key timestamp). Operators: AND, OR, NOT, IN, LIKE, GLOB, IS NULL, comparisons. Examples: kind = 'key' AND last_write >= '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'; data LIKE '%Visual C++%'; path LIKE 'Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\WINEVT%' AND name = 'Enabled' AND data LIKE '1 (%'. DWORD data is indexed as display text such as '1 (0x00000001)'. Each result includes openUri; use it as a Markdown link target whenever citing that registry location.

path.description: Absolute path to the hive file.

where.description: Safe SQL-like WHERE expression without the WHERE keyword. Use last_write with an ISO 8601 timestamp for key update times; data is display text (for example, DWORD 1 is '1 (0x00000001)').

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:extension
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:native && npm run test:integration && npm run test:extension
